title: MEXT School Basic Survey: Collegiate STEM and Computer Science Enrollment and Gender Ratios in Japan
description: Longitudinal administrative monitoring of undergraduate and graduate admissions in science, engineering, and computer science disciplines, tracking institutional expansion and female student participation rates.
observation_unit: 調査年度別の時系列データ系列（2014〜2023年度の計10系列）
sample_population_note: 全国の国公私立大学（約800大学、在学者約300万人、入学者約60万人）を対象とした学校基本調査（文部科学省基幹統計・全数調査）
sample_population_size: 約60万人/年（全国大学学部入学者全数）
title_ja: 【学校基本調査】情報科学・工学系学科入学者数と女子比率の推移

research_angles.title: Gender Parity Trajectories in Collegiate Computing and Engineering Admissions in Japan
research_questions: To what extent has female enrollment in Japanese collegiate computer science programs shifted over the last decade?
Do computer science faculties exhibit distinct gender integration patterns relative to traditional engineering disciplines?
hypotheses: Female representation in computer science demonstrates a statistically significant positive trend.
Overall female STEM enrollment remains below OECD benchmark parity levels.
research_angles.theoretical_framework: Social Cognitive Career Theory & Science Capital (Archer et al., 2015)
